name: What factors affect the resale value of an oceanfront condo?

mainEntity.name: What factors affect the resale value of an oceanfront condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors affect the resale value of an oceanfront condo, including direct ocean views, building amenities, condition of the unit, and the financial health of the HOA. Desirable locations like Aventura, Miami Beach, or Fort Lauderdale Beach, which Kelby Contreras serves, also play a significant role. Market demand, recent renovations, and proximity to desirable attractions, restaurants, and shops further influence value. A well-maintained building with strong reserves and a desirable location tends to hold its value better in the long term.
acceptedAnswer.description: Resale value for oceanfront condos is influenced by ocean views, building amenities, unit condition, HOA financial health, and desirable locations within South Florida's coastal markets.
